risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX in crisis territory (297), strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings binary event in 50 days compounds downside risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Momentum oscillators (RSI, MACD, Stochastic) all lack bullish confirmation, macro environment is severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, strong dollar, earnings binary in 50 days), and no institutional accumulation or insider conviction supports the move.
